title: The Hollow Echo
author: Vesper Dravenmoor
blurb: Petra Vasquez, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
